name: print-social-green-business-conversion-post-with-glowing-horizon
title: Dark green 'Does your business work hard... but not converting?' post with a lime glowing horizon
whatItIs: A portrait post in deep green with a pixel-step logo, a two-part question headline ('Does your business work hard...' then 'but not converting?' in an outlined box), a bright lime glowing planet arc across the middle, a small chevron, a supporting line and a 'Talk to a specialist' button with an arrow tile.
whatItMeans: Suspenseful and direct; the rising glow feels like a turning point, selling a solution after naming the pain.
techniques: Split the headline into setup and outlined punchline.
Use a glowing horizon arc to divide problem and answer.
Pair a solid arrow tile with an outlined button.
Keep one saturated hue on near-black.

vocabulary.definition: A layout naming a pain then offering a fix.
A thin stroke frame around text for emphasis.
